1 In the margin at the sign is added ἀγαθόν. 2 Should one read στρατείαν for στρατιάν?
3 γήματι cod. εὐπιθής cod. 5 μετράν cod. 7 τρόφημον cod. 10 Ἡ cod., Τῇ
we wrote. 13 γενόμενον cod., γεννώμενον we wrote. ἀπολλούμενον cod. and

summary.headline: Lunar Days and Omens
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon in Pisces, covering travel, war, sailing, marriage, illness, planting, building, sowing, theft, and hunting. A new lunar-day examination assigns omens and practical guidance to the first six days, including birth, light-bringing, rising, increasing, exaltation, and raising.
